shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "-----THEMING" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && echo "-----SRC" && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done && echo "=== index.html" && cat index.html && echo "=== vite/tsconfig" && cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && echo "=== node_modules uikit" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo "-----"; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme SegmentedRadioGroup Switch 2>&1 | head -120; echo "-----"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/* 2>/dev/null | head -30

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme SegmentedRadioGroup 2>&1 | head -80; echo "-----"; grep -rl "ThemeProvider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "-----"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -name "ThemeProvider*.d.ts" | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo "-----"; cat theme/index.d.ts; echo "-----"; cat theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "-----"; ls theme; echo "-----"; find . -path "*SegmentedRadioGroup*" -name "*.d.ts" | head; echo "-----"; find . -name "SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts" -exec cat {} \; | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -A12 "export interface ControlGroupProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; grep -n -A6 "export interface ControlGroupOption" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo "-----"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts
